description: Search WhatJobs job listings in 58 countries: jobs by role and place, salary ranges, companies hiring, job counts across cities or roles, recently posted jobs, and jobs that fit your experience. Every result links to WhatJobs, where you can apply.

defaultPrompt: How much does a software engineer earn in Berlin?
Who is hiring data analysts in Paris?
interface.longDescription:
WhatJobs lets you search and explore jobs from WhatJobs job sites in 58 countries, right inside ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Search jobs by role and place, and browse results as cards showing the title, company, location, salary when available and when the job was posted.
- See what a role pays: the typical salary range, median, lowest and highest salary from current listings (in countries where salary data is available).
- Find out which companies are hiring for a role in a place.
- Compare how many jobs are open across cities or roles.
- See only recently posted jobs.
- Find jobs that fit your experience: share your target job titles and skills and get listings ranked by fit, with the matching skills shown.

Job details appear as written on each country's WhatJobs site, and every listing links to the full job on WhatJobs, where you can read more and apply.

Countries: United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Germany, India, Pakistan, Brazil, Spain, United Arab Emirates, Mexico, Argentina, South Africa, Austria, Australia, Belgium, Bahrain, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Switzerland, Dominican Republic, Algeria, Nigeria, Netherlands, France, Denmark, Egypt, Indonesia, Malaysia, Oman, Philippines, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Tanzania, Uganda, Finland, Greece, Guatemala, Hong Kong, Ireland, Italy, Kuwait, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Morocco, Norway, New Zealand, Panama, Peru, Poland, Puerto Rico, Portugal, Russia, Sweden, Thailand, Turkey and Venezuela.

For countries whose listings can't be shown here yet, WhatJobs links you to that country's own site to search there.

WhatJobs only reads public job listings. It never applies for jobs on your behalf and does not need an account.

positive.description: Search for jobs by role and city
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the WhatJobs widget with nurse job cards in London (title, company, location, salary when available, posting date). Each card has an Apply on WhatJobs button that opens the job on uk.whatjobs.com, and the last card links to all matching jobs on WhatJobs.

positive.description: Salary for a role in a city
positive.prompt: How much does a software engineer earn in London?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the typical salary range, median, lowest and highest salary from current WhatJobs listings that state a salary, with a few of those listings and a button to see all matching jobs on WhatJobs.

positive.prompt: Who is hiring software engineers in Berlin?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the companies with the most current software engineer listings in Berlin, with their job counts and a link to an example listing for each. The widget text is in German, matching de.whatjobs.com.

positive.prompt: Show me nurse jobs posted today in Sydney
positive.expected_behavior: Shows only nurse jobs in Sydney posted today or yesterday, newest first, each linking to the job on au.whatjobs.com.

positive.description: Jobs that fit the user's experience
positive.prompt: I'm a data analyst with SQL, Python and Power BI. Which jobs in London should I apply for?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to 10 London jobs ranked by fit, each with a line such as 'Matches: Data Analyst · SQL, Python, Power BI', plus links to all jobs for each suggested job title on WhatJobs. Only job titles and skills are sent to the tool, never personal details.

negative.description: Writing a cover letter is not a job search
negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing manager role
What's the weather in London tomorrow?

negative.description: Interview preparation is not a job search
negative.prompt: Help me prepare for a software engineering interview

publication.release_notes:
Version 2.3.0
- 33 more countries (58 in total).
- In countries whose listings can't be shown here yet, results link to that country's WhatJobs site.
- Clearer messages when a search finds no jobs.
- Faster results when WhatJobs is slow to respond.
